description: Tracker-only handoff record for the ward-cli worker renewal after WCLI-15 (opum-agent, 2026-10-21). The live tracker and repository outrank it.
implementationNotes:
Renewal handoff after WCLI-12, 72, 73 and 15 all landed (opum-agent, 2026-10-21). The live tracker and repository outrank this note; where they differ, this is stale.

STATE (verified at write time)
- origin/dev head is the WCLI-15 completion commit on top of 81caf85 (T26, #157). Landed this session: #152 e2ee2ea (WCLI-72), #154 1142ac1 (WCLI-73), #156 6d4f0e2 and #157 81caf85 (WCLI-15). No open PRs of mine. Remote heads: dev and main only. Local branches: dev and main.
- Open follow-ups: WCLI-76 (guard deleteService to the opum.ward.qualify- prefix, low, opum-doc NIT); WCLI-74 (low, mid-flight profile revoke still fails completion, accepted audit gap).
- Still open per DEC-217 and not started: Q3 split-tolerance ADR; Q6 signing as an A/B to the operator via opum-agent; the profileSnapshotVersion bump under ADR 0018 (release commit, step 1 of docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md); egress proxy only after the first release.
- Release-only items recorded in docs/security-tests.md, not done: T24 behavioural halves (scripts/run-eval.sh Claude run, Codex manual smoke), T25 federated index, and a real or loopback-TLS send for T26 (DEC-217 (a3)).
- .claude/worktrees/review-149-408161b stays registered (DEC-208); never remove a review worktree.

HOW T26 IS RUN: WARD_QUALIFY_REAL_KEYCHAIN=1 bun scripts/qualify-packaged.ts, on macOS only, by a person. It builds dist/ward-qualify (own opum.ward.qualify-<random> service, no runtime override in the shipped binary), uses a temp HOME that symlinks only the login keychain file, and never reads the real opum.ward item. Re-run at each release.

THINGS THAT BIT, so you skip them
- A bare temp HOME hides the login keychain (vault_key_unavailable); link login.keychain-db into it. An item is owned by its creating build: delete with /usr/bin/security delete-generic-password -s <service>, not AsyncEntry. /usr/bin/script refuses a socket stdin: use the python pty bridge.
- Bring a PR up to date by MERGING dev into its branch, never rebase onto a copy branch and never force-push or git push --delete (each raises an operator dialog).
- A stale pre-squash SHA lands in docs/log.md when lore sync runs on a branch; swap in the squash SHA in the completion PR and delete the stale lines.
- A PR whose base is not dev gets no CI (the workflow is scoped to base dev); close and reopen after retargeting.
- The verification agent profile sits at its 20000 budget: every docs growth means narrowing a source (never max_tokens). Dropped so far: ADR 0006, ADR 0005, ADR 0007; ADR 0022 added.
- Hooks refuse shell variables in paths (use literal paths), refuse a git push joined to another command, and refuse GIT_EDITOR (use git -c core.editor=true).
- Local lore and quest are 0.14.1 against the 0.13.0 CI pin: lore check shows schema-drift errors that are the binary; lore validate --strict plus scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs are the comparable gates.
- Never handle a real secret; tests and the T26 run use synthetic values only.
